description:
Unleash your wildest fantasies with the Horned Devil – a vibrating pillow grinder adorned with vibrant bumps and ridges, meticulously crafted for intense stimulation.

Adjustable straps attach it to your pillow, thigh or chair, and two separate zones take bullet vibrators (sold separately) so you can tailor the buzz.

Explore the Horned Devil in 3D

Spin it, slide the diameter ring to measure it at any point, compare it with a soda or Monster can, and tap the AR button on your phone to see it at real size in your room.

Why you'll love the Horned Devil

  • Bumps and ridges for a stimulating grind
  • Two bullet vibrator zones (vibrators sold separately)
  • Includes 2 pillow straps and 4 silicone loop protectors
  • Soft or ultra-soft silicone
  • Handmade in Australia from skin-safe silicone – Australian Made Certified

Make it yours

Pick your density, then list two colours and/or glitters (the colour charts are in the gallery). No colours listed? We'll choose a stunning combination for you. Made to order – ships in 2–5 business days in plain, unmarked packaging.

sections.title: In the box
sections.html:
Horned Devil, 2 pillow straps and 4 silicone loop protectors.

Bullet vibrators are sold separately.

Care: do not boil the pillow straps or loop protectors – boiling water damages them. Remove them before sterilising your silicone kreature.

sections.title: Materials & Colours
sections.html:
The Horned Devil is handmade in Australia from high-grade, skin-safe, soft-touch silicone (choose soft or ultra soft). All our silicone toys are Australian Made Certified.

Colours: list two colours and/or glitters when you order – see the colour charts in the gallery. The charts are a reference guide only: colours shift once mixed into silicone, and every pour is unique. If no colours are listed, we'll select a stunning combination for you.

sections.title: Ways to Play
sections.html:
Grind: strap it to a pillow and ride for a hands-free session.

Add vibration: use one or two bullets for gentle or intense buzz.
